compatibilityIssues: Migration from Web Forms to .NET 8 required
upgradeSteps: Refactor Web Forms to Razor Pages/MVC

issues.impact: Complete data access layer rewrite required. All Entity Framework 6 specific code must be updated to EF Core syntax.
issues.description: The application uses Entity Framework 6.2.0 which is not compatible with .NET 8. Must be upgraded to Entity Framework Core 8.0.0.
issues.recommendation: Replace with Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 8.0.0, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer 8.0.0, and Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design 8.0.0
issues.title: Entity Framework 6.2.0 Incompatible with .NET 8

issues.impact: All logging statements need to be updated. Configuration files need migration.
issues.description: log4net is a legacy logging framework not recommended for .NET 8. Should be replaced with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.
issues.recommendation: Replace with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging 8.0.0 or Serilog.AspNetCore 8.0.0
issues.title: log4net 2.0.10 Legacy Logging Framework

issues.codeSnippet: using System.Web; using System.Web.UI; using System.Web.Optimization;
issues.impact: Core application architecture needs to be rewritten. No direct migration path available.
issues.description: Extensive use of System.Web namespace which is not available in .NET 8. Found in 15+ files.
issues.recommendation: Replace with ASP.NET Core equivalents: IHttpContextAccessor, Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc, etc.
issues.title: System.Web Dependencies Throughout Application

issues.impact: Complete UI layer rewrite required. Page lifecycle events, ViewState, and postback model need replacement.
issues.description: All .aspx pages need complete rewrite to Razor Pages or MVC Views as Web Forms is not supported in .NET Core/.NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Convert to Razor Pages (.cshtml) with PageModel classes or MVC Controllers with Views
issues.title: Web Forms Pages Must Be Rewritten

issues.impact: Layout structure needs complete redesign using ASP.NET Core Layout Pages
issues.description: Master Pages (Site.Master, Site.Mobile.Master) are Web Forms specific and not supported in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Convert to Layout Pages (_Layout.cshtml) in ASP.NET Core
issues.title: Master Pages Incompatible

issues.impact: All user controls need to be rewritten as ASP.NET Core components
issues.description: User Controls (.ascx files) like ViewSwitcher.ascx are Web Forms specific and not supported in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Convert to Partial Views, View Components, or Razor Components
issues.title: User Controls Not Supported

issues.impact: Complete application initialization rewrite required
issues.description: Global.asax and HttpApplication events are not supported in .NET 8. Application startup logic needs migration.
issues.recommendation: Move application startup logic to Program.cs and use ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline
issues.title: Global.asax Application Events

issues.impact: All configuration settings need to be migrated to new format
issues.description: Web.config configuration system is replaced by appsettings.json in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to appsettings.json configuration system with IConfiguration
issues.title: Web.config Configuration System

issues.impact: Dependency injection container needs reconfiguration
issues.description: Using legacy Autofac version. While Autofac supports .NET 8, this version is outdated and Web-specific.
issues.recommendation: Replace with built-in .NET 8 Dependency Injection or upgrade to Autofac 7.x+ with proper .NET 8 integration
issues.title: Autofac 4.9.1 Legacy Version

issues.codeSnippet: protected void Page_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
issues.impact: All page event handlers need to be rewritten
issues.description: Web Forms page lifecycle events like Page_Load are not available in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Convert to Razor Pages OnGet/OnPost methods or MVC Controller actions
issues.title: Page Lifecycle Events (Page_Load)

issues.impact: All server controls need manual conversion to HTML/Razor syntax
issues.description: Web Forms server controls like ListView and HyperLink are not available in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace with HTML elements, Razor syntax, and modern client-side frameworks
issues.title: Server Controls (ListView, HyperLink)

issues.impact: All data binding expressions need conversion to Razor syntax
issues.description: Web Forms data binding syntax (<%#:Item.Property%>) is not supported in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Convert to Razor syntax @Model.Property or use strongly-typed views
issues.title: Data Binding Syntax

issues.impact: All routing configuration needs to be rewritten
issues.description: Web Forms routing system is different from ASP.NET Core routing.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to ASP.NET Core endpoint routing configured in Program.cs
issues.title: RouteConfig and Web Forms Routing

issues.impact: Session configuration needs to be moved to code-based configuration
issues.description: Session state configuration in Web.config needs migration to ASP.NET Core session middleware.
issues.recommendation: Configure session state using AddSession() and UseSession() middleware in Program.cs
issues.title: Session State Configuration

issues.impact: Asset bundling and minification system needs replacement
issues.description: Web Forms bundling and minification system is different in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Use WebOptimizer, Webpack, or built-in ASP.NET Core bundling features
issues.title: Bundle Configuration System

issues.impact: All HttpContext.Current usages need to be replaced
issues.description: HttpContext.Current pattern used in Global.asax is not available in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Use IHttpContextAccessor dependency injection for accessing HttpContext
issues.title: HttpContext.Current Usage

issues.impact: Telemetry configuration needs to be migrated
issues.description: Application Insights configuration for Web Forms needs migration to ASP.NET Core format.
issues.recommendation: Use Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.AspNetCore package and configure in Program.cs
issues.title: Application Insights Integration

issues.impact: All HTTP modules need to be rewritten as middleware
issues.description: HTTP modules defined in Web.config need to be converted to ASP.NET Core middleware.
issues.recommendation: Convert HTTP modules to ASP.NET Core middleware components
issues.title: HTTP Modules Configuration

issues.impact: File path resolution needs to be updated
issues.description: Server.MapPath functionality needs to be replaced with IWebHostEnvironment in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Use IWebHostEnvironment.ContentRootPath or WebRootPath
issues.title: Server.MapPath Equivalent

issues.impact: Complete UI interaction model needs redesign
issues.description: Web Forms ViewState and postback model has no direct equivalent in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Implement stateless design or use client-side state management
issues.title: ViewState and Postback Model

recommendations: Migrate Entity Framework 6 to Entity Framework Core 8. Update all DbContext classes, entity configurations, and LINQ queries. Use EF Core migrations instead of database initializers.

Complete UI rewrite using ASP.NET Core Razor Pages or MVC. Convert all .aspx pages to .cshtml pages with PageModel or Controller classes. Implement modern HTML/CSS/JavaScript instead of server controls.
Replace Autofac with built-in .NET Core dependency injection container. Configure services in Program.cs using AddScoped/AddSingleton/AddTransient methods.
Migrate Web.config settings to appsettings.json. Use IConfiguration and Options pattern for accessing configuration values.
Replace log4net with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging or Serilog. Update all logging statements to use structured logging patterns.
Convert Global.asax application events to Program.cs startup configuration. Use ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline for cross-cutting concerns.
Replace Web Forms bundling with modern asset management. Consider WebOptimizer, Webpack, or ASP.NET Core bundling features.
Implement comprehensive testing strategy with unit tests for business logic, integration tests for data access, and end-to-end tests for UI functionality.
